semiconductor_relevance: High — Pioneer Semiconductor Machine Co., Ltd. specializes in semiconductor testing and sorting equipment, making it a relevant player in the semiconductor industry.
summary: Pioneer Semiconductor Machine Co., Ltd. (PSMC) focuses on providing high-quality handlers and testing equipment for the semiconductor industry. With nearly 30 years of experience, PSMC partners with major trading companies to deliver advanced technical solutions and excellent service to its customers in Taiwan.

regional_presence.Taiwan: PSMC operates as a semiconductor equipment distributor in Taiwan, leveraging a strong customer base and professional technology.
